children: US marketing platform's Q3 revenue rose 55% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Q3 adjusted EPS and net income both beat analyst expectations
Company raised share repurchase authorization to $3.6 bln
Shares surged nearly 22% to $329.50 in after hours trading
AppLovin expects Q4 revenue between $2.37 bln and $2.40 bln
Company sees Q4 adjusted EBITDA of $2.00 bln to $2.03 bln
AppLovin forecasts Q4 adjusted EBITDA margin of 84% to 85%
REVENUE GROWTH - Co attributed record net income to a 55% yr/yr increase in revenue
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 26 "strong buy" or "buy", 7 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for AppLovin Corporation is $440.00, about 79.2% above its November 3 closing price of $245.51
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 21 three months ago
